meta.title: eam_backend crashes at startup — @nestjs/event-emitter missing from Docker anonymous node_modules volume

content.tldr: After Sprint 3 deployment, eam_backend failed to compile with 4 TS2307 errors for '@nestjs/event-emitter'. The package is in package.json and was correctly installed on the host, but Docker re-used a stale anonymous volume for /app/node_modules that was created before the package was added.
content.environment: eam_backend container (Docker development target). Reproducible on any machine that ran 'docker compose up -d --build' without renewing anonymous volumes after a new npm package was added.
steps_to_reproduce: Install @nestjs/event-emitter on the host: cd backend && npm install @nestjs/event-emitter --save
Run: docker compose up -d --build   (normal rebuild — does NOT renew anon volumes)
Observe 4 TS2307 errors: Cannot find module '@nestjs/event-emitter'
content.expected_behavior: NestJS compiles cleanly and all order/invoice routes are mapped. @nestjs/event-emitter is resolvable because npm ci installed it during the image build.
content.actual_behavior: TypeScript compilation fails with TS2307 in: app.module.ts, invoices.service.ts, orders.service.spec.ts, orders.service.ts. NestJS never starts.
content.root_cause: docker-compose.yml defines an anonymous volume '- /app/node_modules' on the backend service. This volume is created on first container start and populated from the image layer. On subsequent 'docker compose up --build' the image IS rebuilt with the new package.json, but Docker REUSES the existing anonymous volume. The bind-mount '- ./backend:/app' overlays the host source, and the stale anonymous volume shadows /app/node_modules — missing @nestjs/event-emitter entirely.
content.fix_description:
Recreate the backend container forcing Docker to discard the stale anonymous volume:

  docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes backend

This creates a fresh /app/node_modules from the rebuillt image layer (npm ci was run against the updated package.json). NestJS started cleanly; all 10 Sprint 3 routes registered.
content.prevention: After adding new npm packages to a project using Docker Compose with anonymous node_modules volumes, always use '--renew-anon-volumes' on the next 'docker compose up'. The migrate.ps1 script already handles this pattern for the migrate service.

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: Bug discovered when eam_backend container failed to start after Sprint 3 deployment. 4 TS2307 errors for @nestjs/event-emitter.

audit.author: vibe-devops-docker
audit.note: Ran: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes backend. Container started; Nest application successfully started confirmed in logs.
